content: Difficulty is what shows what human beings truly are.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Hae peristaseis tous andras deiknyousin — Epictetus (Discourses I.24)
explanation: When life is smooth, sunny, and wealthy, anyone can recite philosophical platitudes and pose as a saint. But when disaster strikes, when you are slandered, broke, or in physical agony—that is the exact moment the mask drops and your true spiritual caliber is revealed.
practicalInsight: When facing a crisis or breakdown today, treat it as an athletic arena: 'Here is my chance to show what a Stoic can bear.'
reflectionPrompt: What has your recent behavior during stress revealed about the actual state of your soul?
